assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied image into a production-ready character SPRITE ATLAS. The input image is the reference for the ONE SAME original athlete's identity, face, short dark hair, medium-tan skin, deep forest-green singlet, almost-black green shorts and ivory sprint spikes with subdued gold detail. Preserve this exact character and the reference's visual quality. Remove the stadium, track, crowd and every background pixel. Deliver a real transparent-alpha PNG, no matte, no fake checkerboard, no ground plane, no shadows baked into the image, no UI, no text, no frame numbers, no grid lines. Each character is a clean isolated full-body cutout. Same camera, body proportions, head size, uniform, lighting and color in every cell. No clipping of head, hands, elbows or shoes. No overlapping neighboring cells, no duplicate bodies or extra limbs. Transparent margins between characters. Layout: exactly FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, twelve equal square cells, a 4:3 landscape atlas about 1536x1152. Read cells left to right, then top to bottom. All figures face RIGHT in STRICT LATERAL SIDE VIEW, not 3/4. Fixed hip horizontal center at 50 percent of each cell. Fixed imaginary ground line at 90 percent cell height; at least one supported foot reaches that line for contact poses. Maintain the SAME scale: ordinary standing head about 18 percent cell height and soles at 90 percent, leaving room above head for raised arms without shrinking the person. Upper two rows are eight DISTINCT successive phases of ONE anatomically correct running cycle, evenly spaced: cell 0 near leg forward landing and far heel tucked back; 1 near leg in grounded mid-stance under hip and far knee recovering forward; 2 near leg pushing backward at toe-off and far knee driven forward; 3 flight/recovery as the far leg extends to land; 4 opposite-leg landing, swapping the near/far roles of cell 0; 5 opposite grounded mid-stance; 6 opposite toe-off; 7 opposite flight/recovery returning to cell 0. Contralateral arm swing, elbows naturally bent, normal knee direction. Row three has FOUR different full-body poses at the same scale and ground baseline: cell 8 relaxed standing ready, arms down, right-facing profile; cell 9 standing after finish catching breath, both feet planted, hands at waist, profile facing right; cell 10 both arms half-raised in a victory gesture with both feet planted; cell 11 full overhead V victory arms, both feet planted, hands not clipped. No jumping displacement in the standing/victory cells. This sheet will animate in a game: clean silhouette and CONSISTENT POSITION AND SCALE are more important than decorative composition. Style: genuinely photorealistic sports photography as in the reference: detailed skin, believable muscle/tendon anatomy and natural technical fabric, warm directional afternoon key light with soft cool fill; no flat vector shading or painterly illustration.
